# SI Photo Booth

> SI Photo Booth is an Atlanta, Georgia photo booth rental company for weddings, corporate events, proms, birthdays, graduations, quinceañeras and more. Booths: Open-Air, Enclosed, 360° Video and Glam. Every rental includes a professional on-site attendant, unlimited instant prints, custom print templates, and instant digital sharing.

Website: https://siphotoboothatl.com
Phone: (943) 255-2632
Email: siphotoboothatl@gmail.com
Service area: Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Lawrenceville, Kennesaw, Midtown and surrounding Georgia
